newsitem.title: USA: INSO sees charge, stock plunges.
newsitem.headline: INSO sees charge, stock plunges.

text.p: Inso Corp. said Wednesday it expects to post a second-quarter charge of between $3.5 million and $4.5 million for its acquisition of LEVEL/5 Research Inc., another software developer, sparking a sell-off of Inso's stock.
Inso plunged $9.125, or more than 25 percent, to $26.625 on Nasdaq.

Inso, which provides multilingual software products, said the charge will reflect the write-off of some technology under research and development at LEVEL/5, a developer of data search software and systems. Inso paid $5 million cash to Information Builders Inc. for the company.
The Boston-based company also said some contracts that it had expected to close during the first quarter were not completed until early in the second quarter.

Inso said its earned $2.5 million, or 18 cents per share, in the quarter ended March 31, after a previously announced acquisition charge of $1.8 million. This compared with a loss of $1.3 million, 10 cents per share, in the year-ago period, which includes an acquisition charge of $4.4 million.
Revenues surged 53 percent to $19.1 million from $12.5 million, it said.
Inso's products are used in proofing, searching and electronic publishing markets worldwide.
